en.title: Number of Binary Palindromic Subsequences of Length 5
en.description:
Choose 5 increasing indices that form a palindrome; different indices count as different subsequences, without deduplicating by text. Output the result modulo 1000000007.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site; missing numeric bounds and recoveries of source typos are all stated explicitly.
en.input: One line containing a 01 string; complete OCR range 5≤length≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 5; 3; 0. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: A palindrome has the form abcba, giving 8 patterns in total. Count each fixed pattern with a subsequence DP updated in reverse order, then sum them.
